question: In March 2022, which bank launched 'Project Banksakhi' in Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In March 2022, Bank of Maharashtra launched 'Project Banksakhi' in Odisha.
 
• The project aims to provide doorstep banking services in remote areas of Odisha.
 
• It is part of the bank's initiative to enhance financial inclusion and reach out to unbanked and underbanked regions.
 
• Under this project, women from self-help groups are trained as 'Banksakhis' to offer basic banking services.
 
• This initiative helps in empowering women by providing them with employment opportunities and financial literacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bank of Maharashtra is a major public sector bank in India with a significant presence in the state of Maharashtra.
 
• The bank was founded in 1935 and has its headquarters in Pune.
 
• It offers a wide range of banking products and services to its customers, including personal banking, corporate banking, and agricultural banking.
 
• The bank has been actively involved in various social and community development initiatives across the country.
